scripts.build: npm run build:prepare && npm run build:css && npm run build:js
scripts.build:css: cleancss -o css/generated/site.min.css css/style.css && node scripts/build-home-css.mjs && cleancss -o css/generated/app.min.css css/pages/app.css && cleancss -o css/generated/cv.min.css css/pages/cv.css && cleancss -o css/generated/engineering.min.css css/pages/engineering.css && cleancss -o css/generated/portfolio.min.css css/pages/portfolio.css
scripts.build:js: terser js/theme.js -c -m -o js/generated/theme.min.js && terser js/navigation.js -c -m -o js/generated/navigation.min.js && terser js/chinagraph-authentic-marks.js -c -m -o js/generated/chinagraph-authentic-marks.min.js && terser js/main.js -c -m -o js/generated/main.min.js
